channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Oil prices drop more than 2% as a pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities raises de-escalation hopes
item.description: Speaking to reporters aboard Air Force One on Monday en route to Michigan, Trump dismissed suggestions that the U.S. was running short on weapons.

item.title: U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked — and that could be a worry for investors
item.description: The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 recently climbed to about 0.50, its highest level since 2021, according to data provided by Rayliant.

item.title: U.S. stock futures slip, South Korea's Kospi plunges over 8%: Live updates
item.description: S&P 500 futures drop. Investors are bracing for a big week of megacap earnings and a Federal Reserve meeting.

item.title: Apple ends day as world's most valuable company, passing Nvidia
item.description: Nvidia had held the top spot as the most valuable company since June 2025, when it took the crown from Microsoft.

item.title: SK Hynix shares plunge 13% in Seoul as chip sell-off deepens
item.description: South Korean semiconductor shares tumbled on Tuesday, extending a rout in chipmakers after another weak session on Wall Street.

item.title: Big earnings and a Fed meeting: What NYSE insider Jay Woods is watching this week
item.description: It's a big week on Wall Street with a Federal Reserve meeting and a barrage of earnings — any of which could sway the stock market, NYSE insider Jay Woods says.

item.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to intervene to allow mail-in voting restrictions
item.description: A federal appeals court on Saturday kept the restrictions blocked in 23 states that sued, finding states must prepare for potentially disruptive election changes.

item.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says AI company isn't advocating for ban of open-weight models
item.description: Critics have questioned why Anthropic didn't sign an industry letter last week in support of open-weight models.

item.title: SpaceX has now lost the equivalent of a full Tesla in market capitalization
item.description: Elon Musk's space company has wiped off more than $1.2 trillion in market cap since hitting a high of $225.64 per share in June.

item.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: A U.S.-China debate that's becoming bigger than tariffs
item.description: The AI race is heating up so fast this summer that it's reshaping national priorities in the U.S. and China.

item.title: From 'oil' to 'shock', here's what Kalshi traders expect Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh will say this week
item.description: Kalshi traders are predicting Warsh will mention last week's supply shock at this week's Federal Reserve press conference.

item.title: Trump backs 'fantastic' Warsh while calling for lower rates and citing 'bad intentions' of other Fed officials
item.description: President Trump Monday voiced support for Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh while insisting that the U.S. should have the lowest interest rates in the world.

item.title: Jim Cramer warns AI's circular financing frenzy echoes the dot-com bubble
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said reports of Nvidia backing OpenAI's data center expansion revived memories of the financing arrangements that preceded the dot-com crash.

item.title: Yields are surging on these inflation-protected bonds. How they may fit into your portfolio
item.description: Long-dated TIPS saw yields leap to multiyear highs last week, but investors have a few things to consider before they jump in.

item.title: Indonesian stocks stage massive turnaround, hitting bull market status after clocking a five-year low just last month
item.description: Attractive valuations, quick intervention by regulators and a return of foreign investors have helped propel Indonesian stocks reach bull-market status.

item.title: Sam Altman to meet with Trump administration, senators this week. Here's what he plans to say
item.description: Altman will preview the capabilities of the company's upcoming family of AI models and answer questions about cybersecurity and open-weight models.

item.title: Steve Eisman is starting to have doubts about AI. The 'Big Short' investor just sold a key tech stock
item.description: Steve Eisman is warning that investors may be underestimating the risks if the AI boom fails to deliver on lofty expectations.

item.title: India's Gen Z forced Modi to listen, respond and act — exposing chinks in the ruling party's armor
item.description: In a rare occurrence, Modi's government was forced to concede demands of Gen Z protesters, underscoring their rising influence in the country's polity.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves after hours: Cadence Design Systems, Rambus, Welltower and more
item.description: These are the stocks posting the largest moves in extended trading.

item.title: Tuesday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: The Dow Industrials rose more than 260 points on Monday. Tune in to CNBC on Tuesday for Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg and JetBlue CEO Joanna Geraghty.

item.title: Nvidia's potential $250B backstop for OpenAI is another strike against the AI trade
item.description: This is yet another sign that investors need to look beyond AI stocks.

item.title: Student loan default is rising: 3 ways to start paying down your balance — even on a tight budget
item.description: You can put extra money toward your student loans by earning bank account bonuses, maximizing credit card rewards and negotiating down your monthly bills.

item.title: Trump says U.S. has sold more than $13 billion of Venezuela oil since Maduro's capture
item.description: President Donald Trump said Monday the U.S. has sold more than $13 billion of Venezuelan oil since taking control of the South American nation's energy exports.

item.title: Consolidated food supply may be worsening cyclospora outbreaks, experts say
item.description: Experts say food industry consolidation may be amplifying the cyclospora outbreak, allowing contaminated produce to spread farther.

item.title: Netflix woes setting up for a Hollywood ending, says trader Mike Khouw
item.description: Netflix's stock price may have lost the plot, but its fundamental narrative remains intact.

item.title: Crypto stocks rally thanks to rotation from AI infrastructure; bitcoin miners lag
item.description: Crypto stocks proved some of the top gainers Monday even as the broader market sold off and capital rotated away from chip and AI infrastructure names.

item.title: Sen. McConnell still not cleared to go back to work as he recovers from fall, doctors say
item.description: McConnell's office shared a written statement from the senator apologizing for being unable to attend an annual Kentucky picnic and a physician's assessment.

item.title: JetBlue overhauls fare options, from basic first to flexible economy. Here's what to know
item.description: JetBlue is doing away with its "Core" product and putting economy tickets under a new name.

item.title: Spain and France wildfires force more than 300,000 to flee as Macron calls crisis meeting
item.description: The impact of a gigantic wildfire ravaging France's Bordeaux region and Spain has been like a "clap of thunder" for the local economy, a minister said.

item.title: Nvidia and OpenAI in talks for up to $250 billion backstop to fund AI infrastructure plans
item.description: The backstop would let OpenAI raise debt for a data center campus in Pike County, Ohio, on the strength of Nvidia's credit.
